_doc: Ratchet allowances for the plugin-kernel migration guardrails.
A guardrail fails when the current violation count EXCEEDS its allowance.
Allowances may only be lowered, never raised. Target for every key is 0.
Numbers recorded at P0 (baseline-1.7.0) unless noted. See docs/migration/.
_shimPages_note: One-line forwarding shims in a plugin-owned tree ('fake pluginization'). P5.2 reached the target: all 61 page shims became the real implementations, and 1 misfiled duplicate shim was deleted because no route imported it. src/pages/Student is now empty and src/pages/Teacher holds only the 5 pages that never had a shim.
_deadCode_note: Application-unreachable files. P4.3b.6 lowered this 65 -> 64 by deleting api/modules/pet (10 files, of which 1 was counted): its 17 routes moved into plugins/pet, so the module became unreachable rather than merely unused.
_staticPluginRoutes_note: Static plugin-owned imports in the route entry file. P5.2b reached the target: AppRoutes.tsx is now a renderer over src/app/routing/routeTable.ts, and page modules are looked up in a map generated from that table, so the route layer never names a plugin module. Target reached - this must stay 0.
_legacyFeatureKeySurfaces_note: Files that hardcode a list of the legacy class feature keys. P4 removed the backend copy by deriving the names from the class row and moving the catalogue into the classroom plugin manifest. P5 removed the frontend copy the same way: src/lib/classFeatures.generated.ts is generated from plugins/classroom/plugin.json by `npm run class-features`, and G13 verifies it is up to date. Target reached - this must stay 0.
_adoptedTables_note: P3: plugins that own a table still carrying its legacy name (see PluginDataDeclaration.adopted). Grown by design across P4.3b as domains migrate: classroom 2, economy 3, dungeon 1, gacha 3, slg 2, battles 1, challenge 2, collaboration 5, marketplace 4, portal 3 = 26; P4.3b.5 added system 2 (question_bank, system_settings) = 28; P4.3b.5b added assignments 4 (assignments, student_assignments, exams, student_exams) = 32; P4.3b.5d added parent-buff 1 (parent_activity) = 33; P4.3b.6 added pet 1 (`pets`) = 34. The pet entry is the one increment that did NOT add a new table to the system: `pets` was already the domain's storage, and the P3 reference table it replaced (`p_pet_pets`) was invented and empty. Every entry is renamed to p_<slug>_ by P7 (target 0). Permanently-shared tables (currently `records`) are EXCLUDED and checked separately, as is the one shared-WRITE table (`redemption_tickets`) - see the SHARED_WRITE_TABLES set in plugin-manifest-conformance.test.ts. The ratchet's real guard is that this cannot grow except by migrating another domain, so every increment is enumerated here by hand.
_routeCollisions_note: METHOD+PATH pairs served by more than one controller file. Invisible to the surface snapshot because it compares sets, and only the first registration is reachable. Peaked at 33 mid-migration (every plugin whose legacy module still existed), fell to 1 in P5.3b, and reached the target in P4.3b.6: the last one was plugins/pet vs api/modules/pet on GET /api/pet/students/:studentId, which could not be fixed by deleting the module because the plugin was not an equivalent replacement (4 endpoints, invented tables). P4.3b.6 ported all 17 legacy routes onto the real `pets` table and deleted the module, so this must stay 0 - a new collision means a domain is registered in both places again.
